# Springtail

> > Springtail: Scale PostgreSQL reads without migration through intelligent database replication and proxy routing.

Springtail was a database infrastructure company focused on PostgreSQL read scalability, compatible with Amazon RDS, Aurora, and Supabase. The team was acquired by Shopify and the service is no longer actively developed.

## Key Topics

- PostgreSQL
- Postgres
- Database replication
- Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL
- Supabase
- Aurora
- OLTP and OLAP workloads
- Read scaling
- VPC peering
- Logical replication
- Foreign Data Wrapper (FDW)
- Proxy routing
- SOC-2 compliance
- WAL (Write-Ahead Logging)
- Database instances

## Getting Started

- [Introduction - Springtail](https://docs.springtail.io): Introduction to Springtail: scale Postgres reads without migration
- [Quickstart - Springtail](https://docs.springtail.io/quickstart): Quick setup guide for Springtail with PostgreSQL, RDS, Aurora, Supabase
- [Springtail Joins Shopify | Springtail](https://springtail.io): Homepage announcing Springtail team acquisition by Shopify

## Guides

- [Database Instances - Springtail](https://docs.springtail.io/guides/instances): How-to guide for managing Springtail database instances and VPC peering

## Technical Reference

- [Postgres Compatibility - Springtail](https://docs.springtail.io/concepts/compatibility): Postgres compatibility details: FDW, proxy routing, logical replication
